enchantments.tooltip: Wisdom +6: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.
Wizardry VI: This item grants the wearer +150 maximum spell points. Sorcerers and Favored Souls gain up to double spell points from items.
Efficient Metamagic - Empower Healing II: The additional spell point cost for using the Empower Healing Metamagic feat is reduced by 2 SP.
Lorikk's Champion: With 2 items equipped - Provides a +72 Equipment bonus to healing spell power. With 3 items equipped - Provides a +78 Equipment bonus to healing spell power.
